digest.component_or_area: RP-04 operation-scoped config and provider-auth/runtime bindings
propositions: ADR 0098 records the approved RP-04 decision: Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration with separately owned provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries.
Every external dependency and OSS behavior claim in ADR 0098 must cite specific primary sources or maintained research artifacts from the RP-04 research phase.
ADR 0098 narrows ADR 0049 only at the per-job retrieval/composition seam and explicitly preserves all unaffected decisions without claiming to supersede them.
The Draft Critique identified no unresolved uncited claims, internal inconsistencies, missing constraints, or conflicts with existing ADRs (ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0049, 0050, 0059, 0083).
ADR 0098 was successfully merged to origin/main (commit 349d91bb) after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with no unresolved comments.
